methods.label: Identify the moving geometric object
methods.explanation: A right triangle is a surface, and rotating it produces a cone, a solid figure, illustrating that a moving surface generates a solid. A windshield wiper illustrates that a moving line generates a surface; a meteor and a pen tip illustrate that a moving point generates a line.
